Subject: Backend Engineer Intern - B.Tech CS, Example University (2027)

Body:
Hi Priya,

I'm a final-year B.Tech CS student at Example University graduating in May 2027, and I'd like to be considered for the Backend Engineer Intern role at Nimbus Labs. Tracing every Lambda invocation to show where latency and cost come from is a problem I'd enjoy, since most of my own work runs on AWS Lambda.

The closest project to the role is CareerForge AI, a full-stack web app on React, FastAPI and PostgreSQL with 12 REST endpoints and 40+ automated API tests. I also built Serverless FileFinder, a serverless file service on 6 AWS Lambda functions with DynamoDB metadata search, so the posting's Python and FastAPI stack is familiar ground. Before that, I interned at Example Research Lab.

Day to day I work in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. I'm available for a 6-month internship from January 2027, and for a full-time new-grad role from mid-2027. Either works for me, and I'd be glad to start the internship on whatever date in January suits the team.

My resume is linked below. If my background fits what the team needs, I'd be happy to share more about either project.

Best regards,
